```javascript
function plusLongMot(s) { if (!s || s.trim() === '') return ''; let mots = s.split(' '); let maxLen = 0, result = ''; for (let mot of mots) { if (mot.length > maxLen) { maxLen = mot.length; result = mot; } } return result; }
```

function mediane(tab) { let sorted = [...tab].sort((a, b) => a - b); let n = sorted.length; if (n % 2 === 1) return sorted[Math.floor(n / 2)]; else return (sorted[n / 2 - 1] + sorted[n / 2]) / 2; }
```
